question: The reign of Kumaragupta I the son and successor of ________ was one of peace and relative inactivity.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandragupta II.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kumaragupta I** was the son and successor of **Chandragupta II.**
 
• Kumaragupta I's reign was marked by **peace and relative inactivity**, which was a result of the **stability and prosperity** achieved during the reign of his father, **Chandragupta II.**
 
• Chandragupta II, also known as **Vikramaditya,** was one of the **most powerful kings **of the **Gupta dynasty.**
 
• He expanded the empire through** conquest and diplomacy** and was a patron of **art and literature.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Skandagupta **was the **successor of Kumaragupta I **and ruled during a period of invasion and turmoil.

 
 
• He is known for his** military victories** against the Huns.
 
 
 
• **Samudragupta,** also known as the **Napoleon of India**, was the predecessor of Kumaragupta I and ruled during a period of** great expansion and military conquest.**
 
 
• He is known for his **military campaigns** and **patronage of the arts.**
